the Commission may make

reference.value: compliance orders: warning, requirement to comply, cease and desist; no monetary maximum

reference.quote:
The “higher maximum amount” shall be the greater of —
(a) N10,000,000, and
(b) 2% of its annual gross revenue in the preceding financial year.
reference.value: enforcement orders / penalty or remedial fee: major importance up to greater of N10m and 2% of prior-year annual gross revenue; others up to greater of N2m and 2%; also remedy, compensation, account of profits

reference.quote: imprisonment for a term not more than one year or both
reference.value: offence of failing to comply with s.47 orders: fine up to higher/standard maximum amount, or imprisonment <= 1 year, or both
